correctness.rationale: Finite cyclic-triangle-free oriented graph extensions are exactly the homogeneous limit types by free amalgamation. Unary words avoid a plus preceding a minus. For a prescribed x->y edge, the one additional forbidden triple has sign pair (-,+) at any base vertex, giving the stated exact 4-state transfer matrix, rational generating function, and coefficient n(n+9)4^n/8+3^n. Nonedge channels factor as unary count squared. The strict decrease reduces to a polynomial plus a positive exponential that is proved positive at n=0..3 and by positive polynomial term for n>=4. A direct triple-enumeration verifier corroborates through base size 5; formal recurrence and inequality cover all n.
